{{Quote|Don't forget to tip your FA droids while on Coruscant. They are programmed to blacklist the stingy.|''[[Travels with Gormaanda: Cooking in the Core]]''|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>}}
The '''FA-series''' was a line of [[Service droid/Legends|service droids]] manufactured by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. The [[FA-4 pilot droid/Legends|FA-4 pilot droid]] was one of the most famous models of the line.
